CardDescription.zh:
其芬芳的木材品质和重量适中。

其木材品质和重量适中，树皮可用于鞣制皮革或制作红色染料。
CardDescription.en:
Its fragrant wood is of moderate quality and weight.

Its wood is of moderate quality and weight and its bark can be used to tan leather or used to make red dye.
